hero.title: The Boroughs
hero.about: An eight-episode sci-fi/horror series executive-produced by the Duffer Brothers (Stranger Things), created by Jeffrey Addiss and Will Matthews. In a picture-perfect retirement community, an unlikely band of heroes — played by Geena Davis, Alfred Molina, Bill Pullman, Alfre Woodard, Clarke Peters, Denis O'Hare and Jena Malone — must stop an otherworldly threat that's stealing the one thing they don't have: time. All eight episodes are on Netflix.
hero.why: Sci-fi is your #1 genre, and this stacks supernatural horror, a heavyweight ensemble and Stranger Things pedigree on top of it — a direct multi-signal match for the Foundation / Severance prestige-sci-fi shelf. The Rotten Tomatoes score has firmed up to 94% on 34 reviews, and it lands as a full-season binge so there's no weekly wait. Tonight's marquee pick — and rate it when you're done (1–5⭐ + 2–3 tags).
